description: smoke

LSTM @ FX champion HPs (Exp35: wd=7e-4 bs=16 seed=42 lr=1e-3 ep=100 pat=15) — Fischer-Krauss 2018 EJOR; QQQ exp5 — directly testing FX-winner config on QQQ
MLP @ FX champion HPs (Exp32: residual MLP head_dropout=0.25 seed=0 lr=3e-4 ep=50 pat=10 wd=1e-5) — Gu-Kelly-Xiu 2020 RFS recipe; QQQ exp6 — testing FX-MLP-winner config on QQQ
MLP @ FX-Exp32 HPs seed=7 — multi-seed variance check on champion
LSTM @ FX-Exp35 HPs seed=0 — multi-seed variance check (vs exp 5 seed=42)
LightGBM @ FX-Exp235-lite n_est=300 (Ke 2017 NeurIPS); QQQ exp8 — first ensemble component
LightGBM @ FX-Exp235 HPs (depth=4 lr=0.01 n_est=1000 seq=60); Ke et al. 2017 NeurIPS; QQQ exp7 — first ensemble component
LSTM @ FX-Exp35 HPs seed=99 — 3rd seed for variance estimate (vs seeds 42, 0)
LightGBM @ FX champion HPs (Exp235: depth=4 lr=0.01 n_est=2000 seq=60) — Ke et al. 2017 NeurIPS; QQQ exp7 — testing FX-LGBM-winner config
MLP @ FX-Exp32 HPs seed=99 — 4th seed for MLP variance estimate
CatBoost @ FX-Exp236-lite n_est=500 (Prokhorenkova 2018 NeurIPS); QQQ — 3rd ensemble component (depth/iterations remap)
Mamba @ SOTA recipe (Gu-Dao 2024 COLM arXiv:2312.00752); seq=60, lr=5e-4, wd=0.1, warmup=10; QQQ first Mamba — testing GPU-saturating backbone
MLP @ FX-Exp32 HPs seed=42 — fills the missing seed (we have 0,7,99). 4-seed multi-seed table will resolve whether MLP champion (exp 6 +0.58 at seed=0) is luck or repeatable.
dMamba @ FX-Mamba-winner config (variant=dmamba expand=4 — Liu 2025 arXiv:2602.09081); Gu-Dao 2024; QQQ — FX-Mamba-phase champion retry (kwarg fix)
CatBoost @ FX-Exp236 FULL n_est=2000 (Prokhorenkova 2018 NeurIPS); QQQ — testing the long-run path now that harness reaping is fixed
dMamba @ FX-Mamba-winner config seed=0 — multi-seed variance verification on the new global champion (exp 17 was seed=42)
dMamba @ FX-Mamba-winner config seed=99 — 3rd seed for stable champion declaration (seeds 42=+0.86, 0=+0.02)
dMamba @ FX-Mamba-winner config seed=7 — 4th seed (after 42=+0.86, 0=+0.02, 99=-0.86). Building toward seed-ensemble (rank-avg across all dMamba seeds = mean ~+0.5 stable signal).
XGBoost @ FX-Exp203 FULL n_est=1500 (Chen-Guestrin 2016 KDD); QQQ — final FX-winner baseline. Completes the 5-component set for the mega-ensemble.
LSTM @ FX-Exp35 HPs seed=7 — 4th LSTM seed (after 42=+0.83, 0=+0.44, 99=+0.47). LSTM has lowest seed std on QQQ; this run consolidates the multi-seed ensemble component.
LightGBM @ FX-Exp235 HPs seed=0 - multi-seed variance check (vs exp 10 seed=42 +0.48); same discipline that exposed dMamba lucky-seed; Lakshminarayanan 2017 NeurIPS
MLP @ FX-Exp32 seq_len 10 -> 60 (equity-window hill-climb); Fischer-Krauss 2018 EJOR seq=240 prior; Lim-Zohren-Roberts 2019 quarterly window; targets trend-capture on F3/F6/F7
LSTM @ FX-Exp35 seq_len 10 -> 60 (equity-window hill-climb on positive-excess anchor); Fischer-Krauss 2018 seq=240 prior; Lim-Zohren-Roberts 2019 quarterly window; Hochreiter-Schmidhuber 1997 LSTM
MLP @ FX-Exp32 lr=1e-4 (down from 3e-4) - flat-minima hill-climb on lucky-seed champ; Keskar 2017 ICLR; targets 4-seed median improvement vs exp 6 seed=0 lucky
MLP @ FX-Exp32 ep=100 pat=20 (up from 50/10) - longer training stability; Goyal 2017, Fischer-Krauss 2018; tests training-duration as seed-variance lever
MLP @ FX-Exp32 hd=0.30 (up from 0.25) - mild reg increase; Srivastava 2014 JMLR; tests dropout as variance-reduction lever
MLP @ FX-Exp32 bs=16 (down from 32) - small-batch flat-minima per Keskar 2017 ICLR; last MLP HP axis before LSTM pivot
LSTM @ FX-Exp35 hd=0.25 (FAITHFUL port; exp 5 had hd=0.1 default bug) - Srivastava 2014; CLAUDE.md FX learnings; corrects under-regularised exp 5
LSTM @ exp 8 baseline seq=20 (up from 10) - Lim-Zohren-Roberts 2019 JFDS min effective momentum window; Fischer-Krauss 2018 LSTM seq=240 prior
LSTM @ exp 8 baseline wd=1e-3 (up from 7e-4) - Loshchilov 2019 ICLR log-spaced AdamW WD step
LSTM @ exp 8 baseline lr=5e-4 (down from 1e-3) - Smith 2017 cyclical LR; halved log-step for flatter minima
LSTM @ exp 8 baseline ep=200 pat=30 (up from 100/15) - Goyal 2017 longer training; Fischer-Krauss 2018 ep=200 prior
LSTM @ exp 8 baseline warmup=5 (up from 0) - Goyal 2017 LR warmup for stability
LightGBM @ exp 10 max_depth=6 (up from 4) - Chen-Guestrin 2016 KDD canonical tabular ceiling
LightGBM @ exp 10 gbm_lr=0.02 (up from 0.01) - Chen-Guestrin 2016 lr range [0.03,0.1] test
XGBoost @ exp 1 max_depth=4 (down from 6) - Chen-Guestrin 2016 regularised tabular default
XGBoost depth=4 n_est=100 - capacity test between 50 (best) and 300 (worse)
XGBoost depth=4 n_est=200 - upper capacity boundary test (sweet spot between 100 and 300)
XGBoost depth=4 n_est=100 lr=0.03 (down from 0.05) - slower learning at sweet-spot capacity
XGBoost @ exp 42 n_est=150 (up from 100) - capacity hill-climb at lr=0.03
XGBoost @ exp 42 lr=0.02 (down from 0.03) - even slower learning at sweet-spot n_est=100
XGBoost @ exp 44 lr=0.01 (down from 0.02) - extending lower-lr trend
XGBoost @ exp 44 max_depth=3 (down from 4) - Friedman 2001 shallow-boosting
XGBoost depth=3 n_est=200 lr=0.02 - shallow + more capacity test
dMamba @ exp 17 expand=2 (down from 4) - Gu-Dao 2024 paper default; QQQ regularisation test
dMamba @ exp 48 NEW CHAMP seed=0 - multi-seed variance check (vs seed=42 +1.19)
dMamba @ exp 48 expand=2 seed=7 - 3rd seed of multi-seed sweep
dMamba @ exp 48 expand=2 seed=99 - 4th seed for full multi-seed median lock
